Our Story

Slow smoke.
Family made.

We're a family-owned BBQ spot tucked in the corner of a shopping center between Sierra Oaks and Arden Arcade. The smoker runs out front, the family runs the kitchen, and every recipe comes from home. owner to tell his story

Grab your plate and head to the back patio. Sit by the fire pit, finish with a slice of pie, and take a whole one home for later.

You smell Our Family BBQ & Pies before you see it.The Sacramento Bee, January 2024

About this mockup: it's a private preview, not the live site. The logo is the new design. Photos tagged "Real" come from his public Google listing.
